html:
Steel is more than a material — it’s the backbone of progress. From residential housing to large-scale infrastructure, every project requires strength, precision, and reliability. Dass Metal Products, a division of JDass Group, delivers comprehensive steel solutions that meet these demands and support Canada’s growing construction needs.

Comprehensive Steel Solutions

At Dass Metal Products, we provide a full suite of steel products and services tailored to contractors, developers, and government projects. Our offerings include:

  • Steel Framing Systems – Certified and durable solutions used in residential, commercial, and industrial builds.
  • Custom Steel Fabrication – Tailored products designed to exact project specifications.
  • Structural Steel Products – High-quality materials that form the foundation of safe, long-lasting structures.
  • On-Demand Supply – Reliable delivery schedules that ensure projects stay on track.

Every product is backed by CSSBI certification, ensuring compliance with Canada’s strictest quality standards.

Innovation Meets Reliability

Our 300,000 sq. ft. Steel Service Centre in Vaughan, Ontario, is powered by district energy systems, reflecting our dedication to sustainability and efficiency. With advanced fabrication technology and scalable operations, Dass Metal Products can serve both local housing developers and large-scale provincial infrastructure projects with equal precision.

“We don’t just sell steel — we deliver solutions that builders can depend on,” says Preet Dass, Chief Operating Officer of JDass Group.

Leadership That Inspires Confidence

Behind Dass Metal Products is a leadership team that ensures strength on every level:

  • Jaswant Dass (CEO)– The visionary who drives diversification and Canada-first growth for JDass Group.
  • Navjot Dass (Managing Director) – The strategist who secures certifications and positions the metals division as a trusted partner for major projects.
  • Preet Dass (COO)– The operational leader who ensures efficiency, quality, and reliability in every product that leaves the Vaughan facility.

Together, their leadership keeps Dass Metal Products aligned with JDass Group’s mission: building sustainable growth with a Canada-first vision.

Supporting Ontario’s Growth

As Ontario expands housing, transit, and infrastructure, demand for reliable steel solutions is rising. Dass Metal Products is proud to contribute to this growth by:

  • Partnering with developers on housing projects.
  • Supplying certified products for critical infrastructure.
  • Expanding capacity to meet long-term construction needs.

Our solutions don’t just build structures — they build stronger communities and a stronger Canada.

About Dass Metal Products

Dass Metal Products, headquartered in Vaughan, Ontario, is a division of JDass Group. Specializing in certified steel framing, structural products, and custom fabrication, the company is committed to innovation, sustainability, and reliability. Backed by the leadership of Jaswant, Navjot, and Preet Dass, Dass Metal Products continues to deliver steel solutions that shape the future of Canada’s construction industry.
